6.319 rsReportItemInLookupDestinationOrResult
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsReportItemInLookupDestinationOrResult is a critical error that will occur when a Lookup, LookupSet,
or MultiLookup function contains within its Destination or Result function parameter a reference to a
report item via the ReportItems global collection.
